# ex_openzl v0.4.15 - Table of Contents

Elixir NIF bindings for OpenZL, Meta's format-aware compression framework. Extends zstd with typed columnar compression (delta coding, entropy coding) and SDDL format-aware compression graphs.

## Pages

- [ExOpenzl](https://ex-openzl.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ex-openzl.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [ExOpenzl](https://ex-openzl.hexdocs.pm/ExOpenzl.md): Elixir bindings for OpenZL, Meta's format-aware compression framework.
